capabilities: Fill uploaded Excel templates with note properties and linked-note data
Map template cells visually and mark rows to repeat per related note
Filter and select which notes to export from a searchable list
Preview the generated workbook inside Obsidian before saving
Export one or more .xlsx files (file-per-root, sheet-per-root, or single)
extras: UI is currently in Spanish only; the manifest carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice; templates are stored in plugin data.json rather than in notes, with a command to import legacy YAML excel-export blocks; the author lists known v1 limitations (formula adjustment, merged cells, Excel tables) and says mobile support is declared desktop-only until tested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn note properties into formatted Excel workbooks while keeping the template's own design, formulas and layout.
summary: Excel template exporter that fills formatted .xlsx templates with note properties and related-note data, previews the result, and saves the files.
